overview_description.description:
Finch is a technology enabled paid media marketing company. They provide solutions for online advertisers and agencies to improve return on paid media investments. This is achieved by utilizing in-house developed automation and optimization AI tools for paid search, paid social, Amazon, Yahoo, MSN, and DSP. 

Finch helps product brand teams and marketing agencies tell a better value story with data using a collaboration platform that focuses on proactive Signals from our in-app data science models, AI tools, narrative AI, shared knowledge, and actionable insights. Finch Analytics is truly changing how marketing teams and agencies tell a better value story to drive business decisions and reduce agency account churn.

Finch was founded in 2009. Since 2023 Boathouse Capital has been overseeing the growth and path forward, led by CEO Lee Roquet.

product.name: Paid Search
product.description: Service managing paid media campaigns to place ads in front of targeted customers and drive revenue through search engines.

product.name: Paid Social
product.description: Service managing advertising campaigns on social media platforms to build brand awareness and engage target audiences.

product.name: SEO Services
product.description: Service providing search engine optimization including audits, technical fixes, content strategy, and link building to improve organic search rankings.

product.name: Demand Side Platform (DSP) Services
product.description: Programmatic advertising service using real-time bidding to buy digital ad inventory across multiple platforms for targeted audience reach.

product.name: Creative Services
product.description: Service offering design and production of visual and video advertising assets, as well as website design to support brand communication.

product.name: Content Marketing
product.description: Service creating written content including website copy, SEO content, and sales pages to support brand messaging and customer engagement.
